title: Multicolour Ramsey number R_6(3) = R(3,3,3,3,3,3), lower bound
statement: Find a colouring of the edges of K_n with 6 colours 0..5 in which no colour holds a triangle; it shows R_6(3) > n. The best known lower bound is R_6(3) >= 539: a Schur partition of 1..537 into 6 sum-free sets (Chen, Zhu and Long, S(6) >= 537) colours the edge {i,j} of K_538 by the class of |i-j|, so a colouring of K_538 is known and one of K_539 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n colour matrix, one line of n characters per vertex; the character in row i, column j (i != j) is the colour of the edge {i,j}, a digit from 0 to r-1 (colour c must avoid K_(S_(c+1))), symmetric; diagonal characters are ignored (write 0 or -). n <= 2048 is practical.
score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R_6(3) >= n + 1 (larger is better)

best_known.source: R_6(3) >= 539: from S(6) >= 537 (Z. Chen, L. Zhu and F. Long, arXiv:2610.31362) by R_k(3) >= S(k) + 2; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 (24 Apr 2026) printed 538 [FreSw] in Table XIa; read 8 Nov 2026
